notesHint: Connect the chapter title to two to four questions or proof steps the next section will answer.
description_en: A chapter marker opens into the actual section questions, which arrive along one reading path and remain on screen as the next section's agenda.
description_ko: 장 번호와 제목 뒤에 다음 장에서 답할 질문·근거 단계를 순서대로 드러내고, 한 경로에 정지시킵니다.
responsive: Keep the title and all two to four agenda lines visible together; on mobile stack the chapter marker above the steps.
reducedMotion: Show the title, chapter marker, and all agenda lines immediately as a static reading path.
purpose: 다음 장의 실제 질문과 증명 순서를 예고한다.

sceneContract.fit: A real section change whose next two to four questions/proof steps can be stated in concise text.
sceneContract.unfit: A title-only pause, a repeated divider, or a section whose evidence needs an image/data visual.
sceneContract.requiredInputs: A chapter number in copy.kicker, a specific section claim in copy.title, and two to four ordered copy.lines.
sceneContract.scrollBeatSemantics: The numeral opens a visual threshold; the new claim and its actual section steps enter one by one.
sceneContract.stableHold: By 0.48 the full title and every listed step are visible together and stay still through the speaking hold.
sceneContract.projectorTypeCriteria: Chapter numeral supports orientation; title and step labels remain the primary readable content.
sceneContract.labelCriteria: Each line names a real question or proof step in the talk, in spoken order.
sceneContract.mobile: Number moves to the backdrop and all steps remain readable beneath the title in one scene.
sceneContract.reducedMotion: All steps are immediately visible in their reading order with no stagger or movement.
sceneContract.exampleContent: Chapter 02 · From claim to evidence, followed by the questions the evidence will answer.
sceneContract.unsupportedReason: Do not use it to pad a deck with a decorative divider or repeat its numbered card grammar.
sceneContract.nextImplementation: Keep agenda lines concrete and review desktop, mobile, reduced-motion, and the .55 hold.
